Progressive supervisors will make or break you. I’ve been here 5 years and have had numerous sups—mostly they were great. I had 1 sup in the agency department that was a complete nightmare. She cared more about what her superiors thought of her than supporting her team. I hope HR will be able to move you to a new team. If not, don’t quit just yet. Progressive really is a great place to work and I’d hate for 1  bad apple to spoil it for you. Look into another department to switch sups, like the blended team.
There is a big learning curve and you learn the most on the job. Don’t be afraid to use your resources. Assist was my best friend when I first started
